verdict.rationale: Bias reduction is a fair axis for an ATS like Recruitee, but the evidence pack has nothing on structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review, or DEI funnel reporting. The generic 'Reporting & Insights' feature label does not establish DEI reporting. With no documented capability for any part of the story, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an operations lead, the platform helps reduce bias — structured feedback ordering, demographic-blind review options, and DEI reporting on the funnel
